instruction: Slightly turn left from the place you are standing and go straight. You will find sliding door. Now slightly turn left and exit from the door. Now again turn left and step into the door. Right now you are in front of the couch. Now go straight. On the left side you will find table. Now again go straight. On the right side you will find fire place. Now move a step forward. On the left side you will find table. That will be your final destination.
